newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes stronger in volatile trading.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes stronger in volatile trading.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed stronger at C$1.3397 (US$0.7465) from Tuesday's close at C$1.3418 (US$0.7453) after a day of rocking back and forth within its range, traders said. * They said corporate interest at the extreme ends of the range meant volatile and active trading most of the day. * Strong export and import numbers boosted the currency.
Canadian trade data released Wednesday initially weakened the currency but the market was reassured by record high imports and exports, traders said.
Canada's merchandise trade surplus fell in September to C$3.23 billion from a revised surplus of C$3.73 billion in August.
Both imports and exports hit record highs, with imports rising to C$20.28 billion in September from C$19.38 billion in August and exports rising to C$23.51 billion from C$23.11 billion.
On the crosses, the Canada fell to 1.1166 marks from Tuesday's close of 1.1215 marks but rose slightly to 83.21 yen from 83.15 yen.
